answer: One agent earns one maritime license after a coast-guard exam, and ties one vessel registration to it. Three established peers verify the license number in the public registry, the vessel's registration record, and a fresh signature from the key tied to the license. The exam, license, and registration cost $200 to $600 plus weeks of study and an inspection, so a thousand fake identities burns $200,000 to $600,000 and a thousand inspections. Like a falcon that only answers one call, a licensed agent follows one pulse of duty and will not wander into a thousand borrowed names.
